articles.title: Kalshi and Polymarket could become M&A targets as prediction markets consolidate: Bernstein
articles.snippet: The broker said operational consolidation is blurring the lines between exchanges, brokerages and sportsbooks, creating conditions for acquisitions across the prediction market ecosystem.

articles.title: BIS warns stablecoins risk fragmenting global financial system
articles.snippet: The Basel-based institution said that private digital tokens fall short of the requirements for sound money and urged policymakers to accelerate work on tokenized forms of central bank and commercial bank money.

articles.title: Senators Demand Answers From CFTC Over Alleged Polymarket Deceptive Advertising
articles.snippet: Senators are seeking answers from the CFTC about recent allegations of deceptive marketing from Polymarket.

articles.title: Polymarket to Refund Users After Scammers Swipe Millions in Website Exploit
articles.snippet: Hackers infiltrated Polymarket’s website via a compromised third-party vendor, the company said, swiping millions in crypto from users.

articles.title: AI Took Your Job? California Wants to Know
articles.snippet: California launched the nation's first AI unemployment tracker as policymakers race to determine whether warnings of an AI-driven jobs shakeup are becoming a reality.
